nodes.text: Attention team, this is a scheduled evacuation drill for Harbor Tower. Report status through the command channel.
nodes.speaker: PA System

nodes.text: Floor 2 is sweeping west to east and guiding staff toward Stair A.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: Staff from Floor 2 are entering Stair A in an orderly line.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: The finance office is still occupied and needs a second knock.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: Send a backup checker to Floor 2 and keep that zone closed until contact is confirmed.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: The south fire door on Floor 5 is not latching open for the lab team.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: Lab staff are being redirected to the east stairs with the aisle kept clear.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: Engineering is on the way to inspect the blocked fire door.
nodes.speaker: Engineer

nodes.text: Keep Floor 5 on alternate routing and log the blocked door as a corrective action.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: The Floor 5 team is re-running the sweep after the route change.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: The last lab worker is securing the chemical cabinet before exiting.
nodes.speaker: Safety Warden

nodes.text: The lobby desk is matching visitor badges against the sign-in sheet.
nodes.speaker: Reception

nodes.text: One contractor badge is missing from the roll call and the vendor was last checked in upstairs.
nodes.speaker: Reception

nodes.text: The front desk radio has dropped off the command channel.
nodes.speaker: Reception

nodes.text: A runner is carrying the visitor sheet to the command desk by hand.
nodes.speaker: Reception

nodes.text: A mobility-assisted evacuee is waiting near the refuge area and needs routing guidance.
nodes.speaker: Accessibility Lead

nodes.text: The stair-chair team is moving to the refuge area with a spotter on Stair B.
nodes.speaker: Accessibility Lead

nodes.text: The evacuee remains calm in the refuge area while command evaluates timing.
nodes.speaker: Accessibility Lead

nodes.text: Elevators stay out of service during the drill; redirect the request to the assisted-descent procedure.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: Stair traffic is bunching up and needs spacing before the next team descends.
nodes.speaker: Assembly Lead

nodes.text: Command is comparing floor reports, visitor counts, and assembly updates.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: Every badge and visitor tag is accounted for at the assembly area.
nodes.speaker: Assembly Lead

nodes.text: Drill complete. Return teams to normal operations after the debrief.
nodes.speaker: PA System

nodes.text: Drill complete. Keep the blocked-door review open for follow-up.
nodes.speaker: PA System

nodes.text: Two badges are missing from the assembly roster.
nodes.speaker: Assembly Lead

nodes.text: Command is sending a targeted resweep based on the missing badge list.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: The missing badges were part of the drill inject and no live occupants are unaccounted for.
nodes.speaker: Command Chief

nodes.text: Weather has made the outdoor assembly point unsafe; move the drill to the covered garage.
nodes.speaker: PA System

nodes.text: The covered garage is now the temporary assembly location with headcount restarting there.
nodes.speaker: Assembly Lead

nodes.text: Repeat the last status request and keep the routes clear until command confirms the next move.
nodes.speaker: PA System

nodes.text: The assembly point has received another team and updated the roster.
nodes.speaker: Assembly Lead

1. Every visitor matches the log.

3. [Fallback] The lobby radio failed.

1. Send the team back to Floor 2.

3. Keep the current assembly point and re-evaluate.
1. Repeat the all-clear request.
2. Repeat Floor 2 sweep instructions.
3. Repeat mobility assistance instructions.
1. Send the update to command.
2. Start a manual headcount check.
3. Ask lobby to verify visitor badges again.
